# Cv (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Loads the published CV page through GraphQL on the Next server and hands it to the page sanitized ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

`server-only` loader wrapped in React `cache`, so metadata and page share one request per render; richtext is sanitized with DOMPurify before it leaves the server (D13). `mainResumeOf` picks the published `cv-page` with `isMain = true`, the newest if several (Q-G7).

## Technologies

Next.js App Router, the web GraphQL server client, DOMPurify.

## Entry points

Facade `index.ts`: `loadCvPage`, `mainResumeOf`; the BFF route imports `answerCvRead` from `CvPage.server.ts` (reads the session through `features/session` server files); the GraphQL document and types in `Cv.graphql.ts`.

## Where to change what

A new CV field: the query and types in `Cv.graphql.ts` (and the committed SDL in cms-api); render it in `views/cv`.
